title: Pilobol.us P3-10: reader build reads the CMS export (env switch, cms-reader proof branch, in-build parity gate)
description:
## Goal
Switch the reader build to read from the CMS export, behind an env switch, proven on a non-production reader branch (cms-reader) with an in-build parity gate against the live site, while the Git build path stays the default and keeps working.

## Context (FACT, verified 2026-10-06)
- web/build_via_papyrus.py hardcodes POD_ROOT/"content" and POD_ROOT/"dist-papyrus" (also in _source_markdown_for_href and _effect_front_matter_for_slug), imports papyrus_content from PAPYRUS_ROOT/src (a checkout at d664fc7), writes generated listing pages and author front matter into the content dir, and generates robots.txt and sitemap.xml.
- Measured: develop's renderer on the same Git content is byte-identical to the pinned renderer (94 files); the CMS export + no-clobber overlay of Git assets/ builds identical output (94 files).
- export-published is fail-closed on empty or any GraphQL/S3 error, so a CMS outage fails the build and does not publish an empty site.
- Reader build credentials: guest read (the guest-mode ticket) needs the public values PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT, PAPYRUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID, PAPYRUS_MEDIA_BUCKET, AWS_REGION as branch env vars (not secrets). Fallback if D2 chose SSM JWT: a reader service role with ssm:GetParameter on the CMS app's secret path (not recommended).
- Python on Amplify: papyrus-newsroom needs 3.12; the AL2023 image defaults to 3.10 (ASSUMPTION per AWS docs, unverified on this app): the generated spec provisions 3.12 with uv (curl https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh, uv python install 3.12).
- The reader app (after the reader-spec ticket) has an app-level build spec and no repo amplify.yml.

## Exact steps (Pilobol.us repo, feature branch; reader app changes are LIVE)
1. Refactor web/build_via_papyrus.py minimally: arguments or env --content DIR (default web/content) and --out DIR (default web/dist-papyrus); replace the hardcoded paths; import papyrus_content from the installed package when PAPYRUS_ROOT is unset (keep PAPYRUS_ROOT for the Git path). Output for the default path must stay byte-identical (parity harness).
2. Add reader/build.py (the entry used by infra/site.json reader.buildCommand): python3 reader/build.py --content content-export --out dist: assemble a work dir = copy of the export + no-clobber overlay of web/content/assets/ (reader-owned JS/CSS/HTML and unreferenced images), run the build there, never write into the Git tree or the export.
3. Replace the reader app spec with a dispatching spec: if PILOBOL_SOURCE=cms then provision Python 3.12 with uv, uv pip install "papyrus-newsroom[markus]==<pin>" (boto3 must come with it: see the guest-mode ticket), papyrus content export-published --auth guest --out content-export --clean, python3 reader/build.py ...; else the current Git commands unchanged. If PILOBOL_PARITY_LIVE_URL is set, after the build run verify-parity.py --dist <out> --live <url> --narration and fail the build on any difference (no deploy happens on a failed build, so the live site is untouched). Artifacts web/dist-papyrus for both paths. LIVE (Ryan yes): aws amplify update-app --app-id d1od6t7lzbwanr --build-spec file://... Then merge to main only after step 6; first re-run main with no env change and prove 94/94 (the default path did not change).
4. LIVE (Ryan yes): create branch cms-reader on the reader app: aws amplify create-branch --app-id d1od6t7lzbwanr --branch-name cms-reader --stage EXPERIMENTAL --enable-auto-build --environment-variables PILOBOL_SOURCE=cms,PILOBOL_PARITY_LIVE_URL=https://pilobol.us,PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT=...,PAPYRUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID=...,PAPYRUS_MEDIA_BUCKET=...,AWS_REGION=us-east-1 (values from scratch/prod outputs; they are public ids). No domain is mapped to this branch. Ryan checks the reader app's repository connection is the Amplify GitHub App (migrate banner if OAuth).
5. Push git branch cms-reader (same code). Watch the job; the in-build gate must pass: 94/94 and 11/11.
6. Also verify the proof page: the branch URL https://cms-reader.d1od6t7lzbwanr.amplifyapp.com is the same bytes as live (canonical/og URLs point to https://pilobol.us, robots allows: harmless duplicate, short-lived). Do not press play on the Auritus player there.
7. Negative test: break the CMS side (point PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT at a wrong value on cms-reader): the build fails and nothing deploys; then fix it back.

## Acceptance checks
- cms-reader job SUCCEED with the parity gate passing; default Git path rebuilt on main = 94/94 identical.
- Negative test fails the build (fail closed).
- Narration: 11/11 page text hashes equal (so no Auritus job hash changes).

## Rollback
Delete branch cms-reader (aws amplify delete-branch, Ryan yes). Restore the previous app spec (kept in scratch). The repo change is reverted by PR revert. Live site never changed.

## Risks
- Python 3.12 provisioning via an external installer on the build image is unproven (ASSUMPTION): if it fails, use a Python 3.12 build image via the app's custom build image setting or vendor a wheel; budget +1 day.
- The 6,047,745-byte image and other assets must be present: the overlay copies reader-owned files; exported media comes from S3.
- Amplify builds from GitHub's branch: PRs from forks do not get env vars; use branches in the repo.

## Needs Ryan
Yes for the app spec update (step 3), the branch creation (step 4), the merge; confirm the reader app's GitHub connection type (GitHub App moment for app d1od6t7lzbwanr).

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
right_now_summary: The CMS-backed reader build and parity proof are awaiting implementation and Amplify branch testing.
